summary_rationale: Kody Technolab has engineered an impressive technological pivot from an offshore IT services boutique into an indigenous commercial robotics and autonomous systems manufacturer (Odigo, Dasher, Athena), expanding consolidated revenue from ₹11 crore in FY22 to ₹80 crore in FY26 and ₹111 crore on a trailing-twelve-month basis, maintaining reported operating margins above 23%. However, the underlying business quality exhibits acute working-capital absorption, with trade debtor days stretching to 192 days and net working capital days surging to 197 days in FY26. During FY26, operating cash flow of ₹12 crore was heavily outpaced by ₹65 crore in cash capital expenditures, generating deeply negative free cash flow of negative ₹53 crore. In addition, reported profit after tax of ₹17 crore was substantially boosted by ₹7 crore of non-operating other income (which expanded to ₹9 crore in the trailing twelve months), while expansion has necessitated serial equity dilution via preferential warrants that reduced promoter ownership from 73.01% to 68.82%. Consequently, Kody qualifies as an emerging CYCLICAL_CONDITIONAL industrial technology asset rather than a self-sustaining compounder, with its fundamental runway strictly conditioned upon trade receivable monetization, core operating cash conversion, and self-funding capability.
